ratios.facility: New Credit Agreement (New Revolving Credit Facility)
ratios.quote: To the extent that outstanding usage of the New Revolving Credit Facility exceeds 40% of the commitments under the New Revolving Credit Facility as of the last day of any fiscal quarter, LIMC is required to be in compliance with a maximum First Lien Net Leverage Ratio (as defined below) of 5.20:1.00 as of the last day of such fiscal quarter.

parsed.notes: The 5.20:1.00 maximum First Lien Net Leverage Ratio is a springing covenant. It is tested only when revolver usage exceeds 40% of commitments at quarter end. At September 26, 2026 there were no revolver borrowings, so the test was likely not triggered. No actual ratio is disclosed; the filing says only that the company was in compliance with all covenants. Ratio-based pricing grids (interest margins and commitment fees) were excluded.
